row:
All things improvement.
--
Mission: Improve health & build strength.
Side Mission: Eliminate pain.
--
👋Bye pain, hello stronger, healthier you. With over 10+ years of experience & education, I’ve helped thousands of people achieve lasting relief from neck & back pain, hip pain, shoulder pain, sciatica, and more. Whether you're recovering from an injury or looking to improve motion, posture, mobility, flexibility, strength or stability.. I'll cover all of these topics and more.

🧘JP the PT offers expert healthcare education designed to strengthen your body, restore function, and eliminate pain. We cover topics such as DIY at-home physical therapy exercises customized stretches and strength-building routines and more.

👨‍⚕️Stay connected w/ JP the PT & take control of your health today: Like, subscribe, and check our website for free resources! Drop a comment below to get questions answered—let’s work together to heal and feel stronger!
